correctness.rationale: The normalized ancestry extension J_{n,m} is an exact isometric intertwiner for each root-preserving tree automorphism. For every element of the norm-closed generated algebra its finite-level matrix actions are compatible and repeat indefinitely. On an isometric ℓ∞ subspace of copies of any one vector, the operator has constant norm ratio, forcing all finite-rank approximation errors and compact distance to be the full norm. A Fredholm left parametrix gives a uniform lower bound for each square finite block, hence uniform block inverses and genuine invertibility. For p=2 each permutation block is unitary, and the farthest root-of-unity chord produces the sharp √3 gap. A deterministic finite checker passed 5,928 permutation/intertwiner instances; no infinite conclusion depends on the finite checker.

value.rationale: The natural algebra of root-preserving tree symmetries has a complete quantitative rigidity despite arbitrary deep local perturbations: no nonzero finite combination can improve its norm by even finite-rank or compact correction; every spectral obstruction is essential and the generator representation is uniformly separated at sharp distance √3 on the Hilbert-level space. This directly complements new work exhibiting compact cancellation for general composition symbols and gives a meaningful all-elements classification, rather than a small numerical example.
